comment: Single source of truth for the GL transition catalogue. Consumed by backend/app/renderer.py and src/App.tsx. id = ffmpeg transition name (dispatch is case-insensitive). label = UI name shown in pickers; NEVER rename a label (saved projects store it). group = UI optgroup. params = UI controls + defaults (order = positional arg order).

params.name: bgcolor
params.hint: background colour shown while the rect crops in (#RRGGBB or 0xRRGGBBAA)

params.name: map
params.hint: negative = generated texture (even = still, odd = animated); 0..1 = grey, #RRGGBB / 0xRRGGBBAA = colour

params.name: map
params.hint: negative = generated texture (even = still, odd = animated); 0..1 = grey, #RRGGBB / 0xRRGGBBAA = colour

params.name: fromStep
params.hint: per-channel fade start (R,G,B,A steps 0..1 packed as colour); must be below toStep

params.name: toStep
params.hint: per-channel fade end; all channels must be above fromStep
